fuse_gmock_headers: run the script to fuse Google Mock and Google Test source code into two .h files and a .cc file
validate_gmock_root_dir: validate that a given directory is a valid Google Mock root directory with required seed files
validate_output_dir: validate that the output directory can write the fused gtest.h, gmock.h, and gmock-gtest-all.cc files
fuse_gmock_h: scan a gmock root directory to generate a fused gmock/gmock.h header file in the output directory
fuse_gmock_gtest_all_cc: scan a gmock root directory to generate a fused gmock-gtest-all.cc source file in the output directory
